A generic business-name field does not imply that CAB licenses architecture firms. The advanced-search link timed out during retrieval. Its additional fields were not verified.

Separate forms search individuals and listed business entities; neither form was submitted. The authority explains that a business entity using the architect description must nominate a responsible architect and appear on its corporations-and-firms list. Record a business listing separately from each nominated architect and that person’s registration; do not collapse them into one entity.
